id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

topologies.name: Point-to-point
topologies.description: Direct N_Port-to-N_Port link between two devices; full bandwidth dedicated; no fabric / no FLOGI.

topologies.name: Arbitrated Loop (FC-AL)
topologies.description: Up to 126 NL_Ports (plus an optional FL_Port) share a loop; ARB-based arbitration; 8-bit AL_PAs assigned at LIP.

topologies.name: Switched Fabric
topologies.description: N_Ports attach to F_Ports on switches that route frames by 24-bit address; switches interconnect via E_Ports (Inter-Switch Links); fabric services (Name Server, Fabric Controller, Management Server).

port_types.role: Node port on an end device (HBA / target).

fields.notes: Fibre Channel scales from a single point-to-point link, through a shared arbitrated loop (FC-AL, up to 126 NL_Ports), to a switched fabric of millions of addressable ports interconnected by E_Port Inter-Switch Links and discovered through the Name Server.
